The main takeaway from our work is that

the primordial helium abundances obtained from the spectroscopic sample of H II regions, which are the most reliable, are consistent with those from the cosmic microwave background (CMB) and big-bang nucleosynthesis (BBN), and there is no need to invoke any exotic physics to reconcile the CMB and BBN with the spectroscopic sample.
